svg.title: Tol-Pal at an invaginating envelope
svg.desc: Flat section through a Gram-negative envelope bending inward at the division site, all layers together: Pal anchored in the outer membrane binds peptidoglycan and TolB, TolA reaches from the inner membrane and TolQ-TolR sits in the inner membrane.
